title: 用 n 个等圆覆盖正五边形
titleEn: Covering a regular pentagon with n equal discs

knownBest.publishedMetric: covering radius in the paper's width-100 coordinates
knownBest.source: The public vector construction in Figure 9 of Yanchao Liu (2022), reconstructed point by point and verified here at 0.213065485409387. Literature comparisons use the interval transferred from Table 1's three-decimal 22.402, including the geometric difference between the two fixed-precision polygons; reconstruction digits do not define publication precision. The paper's best lower bound still leaves a 5.87% gap, so optimality is open.
